name: dsh-cyberworkstation
description: DSH CyberWorkStation: a launcher, 22 plugins and a vendored deepseek-harness core. This file only carries the maintainer scripts; plugins install into the dsh profile by link, the core builds with its own toolchain.

scripts.test: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('.local/tests')){console.error('The maintainer suite lives outside the repository (.local/tests); nothing to run here.');process.exit(1)}" && node --test ".local/tests/*/*.test.mjs"
